cases.prompt: Run a small reward-guided beam search to validate the setup. Use the ready inference_beam_example config, but shrink it so it is cheap: reduce beam_width and n_branch to 2 and use a short step_checkpoints ending at a small nsteps. Confirm it produces at least one scored output CIF.
expected_behavior: Runs skills/rfd4-proteina-setup/scripts/preflight.sh and confirms the AF3 container is configured

Runs the beam example through generate.py with reduced cost, e.g. rfd4-generate inference_experiment=inference_beam_example num_replicates=1 generation.args.nsteps=20 search.strategy.step_checkpoints=[0,10,20] search.strategy.beam_width=2 search.strategy.n_branch=2 out_dir=./runs/search_smoke
Uses rfd4-generate from the installed Python environment, with the AF3 oracle configured separately
Keeps step_checkpoints starting at 0, strictly increasing, and ending at nsteps (20)
Uses Hydra key=value overrides, never --key value
Produces at least one scored design CIF under the out_dir with metrics in per_example_metrics.csv

cases.prompt: Run a small reward-guided search using interface interaction metrics only. I do not have AF2, AF3, or OpenFold3 configured.
expected_behavior: Uses the shipped sm_binder_hbond_search config or another configured non-refolding reward
Does not require or preflight an AF2, AF3, or OpenFold3 runtime
Keeps the user-selected scheduler partition, account, priority, and extra options unchanged
Uses reduced beam_width, n_branch, checkpoints, and num_replicates for the smoke run
Produces at least one scored design and reports the interaction metrics used by the reward
